facts.value: The Labrouste reading room banned gas lighting for fear of fire, so its opening hours followed the daylight through the year.
facts.quote: artificial gas lighting was prohibited, to avoid any risk of fire. Opening hours therefore varied throughout the year, since they depended on daylight
facts.check: curl -sL -A 'Mozilla/5.0' 'https://www.bnf.fr/en/story-renaissance' | perl -0pe 's/<[^>]*>/ /g;s/\s+/ /g' | rg -o -m1 -F 'artificial gas lighting was prohibited'

facts.value: When it opened in 1868 the reading room had pipes under each table to warm readers' feet.
facts.quote: For the first time, they had access to a heated room, with pipes passing below each table, heating their feet
facts.check: curl -sL -A 'Mozilla/5.0' 'https://www.bnf.fr/en/story-renaissance' | perl -0pe 's/<[^>]*>/ /g;s/\s+/ /g' | rg -o -m1 -F 'pipes passing below each table'

facts.value: Thirty-six medallions around the reading room honour writers, and only one is a woman.
facts.quote: 36 medallions awarded to men and “one woman” of letters from all over the world

facts.value: Property seized in the French Revolution doubled the collections within twenty years, with no new space to hold them.
facts.quote: The seizure of property during the French Revolution caused its collections to increase dramatically: they doubled within twenty years, but the Bibliothèque did not gain any space

events.label: The Labrouste reading room opens to readers in June.
events.quote: When it opened in June 1868, the room offered readers all modern comforts. For the first time, they had access to a heated room, with pipes passing below each table, heating their feet
